$description: Category registry. Every component's meta.json must name one of these ids; the linter enforces it and the Lab builds its menu from this order. Adapted from the Atlassian grouping, minus the app-shell groups, plus the content groups a marketing site needs.

categories.label: Actions
categories.note: Buttons, links, anything that triggers something

categories.label: Content
categories.note: Cards, posts, products, quotes, lists, contact blocks

categories.label: Feedback & status
categories.note: Alerts, notices, toasts, badges, tags, progress
